# Pablo Pavon — Freelance Senior Business & Data Analyst, Berlin

> Pablo Pavon is a freelance Senior Business & Data Analyst based in Berlin, Germany, originally from Argentina. He works remotely with small and mid-sized companies, accounting firms and corporate teams in Argentina, Latin America, Europe and the United States, in English, Spanish and German. He specialises in Power BI and SQL dashboards, data migration with reconciliation, finance automation (bank reconciliation, supplier invoice control, cash forecasting) and AI-assisted reporting where every number is verified before release. Background: banking, e-commerce, marketing analytics and insurance; 10+ years of experience.

Facts: based in Berlin, Germany (CET); from Argentina; languages: Spanish (native), English (C1), German (B2);
fully remote; engagement models: diagnostic, fixed-scope project, monthly support; replies within 1–2 business days.
All dashboards and case studies on the site use synthetic data from fictional companies, and the code is public on GitHub.
Site last updated: 2026-10-21.

## Services
- Dashboards & BI / Dashboards y BI: Power BI, Tableau or web dashboards that replace manual reports: defined KPIs, meaningful filters, one version of the numbers.
- Finance automation / Automatización financiera: Bank reconciliation, supplier invoice control, collections and cash forecasting that update themselves every morning, for SMEs and accounting firms.
- AI applied to processes / IA aplicada a procesos: Reports and repetitive work automated with AI, with checks that verify every figure before anyone reads it.
- Data analysis / Análisis de datos: SQL and Python to answer concrete business questions, with assumptions and limits stated.
- Requirements & processes / Requerimientos y procesos: Discovery, user stories with acceptance criteria, functional specs and process maps that IT can build without guessing.
- Pricing & customer analytics / Pricing y analítica de clientes: Pricing by market and channel, elasticity, cohorts, RFM segmentation, churn and customer lifetime value.
- Data migration & quality / Migración y calidad de datos: Data mapping for system changes, cleansing, deduplication and reconciliations that prove nothing was lost; operational GDPR data management.

## Case studies (English; synthetic data, open code)
- [Automated daily reconciliation and cash](https://pablodpavon.com/proyectos/conciliacion-y-caja.html): bank reconciliation, collections and a 20-day cash forecast that run by themselves every morning. Code: https://github.com/pablodpavon/daily-cash-control
- [Accounts payable control](https://pablodpavon.com/proyectos/cuentas-a-pagar.html): 12 rules over 1,260 supplier invoices, CUIT validation and 3-way match before the payment run. Code: https://github.com/pablodpavon/ap-invoice-control
- [Data migration with reconciliation](https://pablodpavon.com/proyectos/migracion-de-datos.html): spec-driven migration of 4,060 customers and 6,500 contracts with 12 reconciliation checks. Code: https://github.com/pablodpavon/data-migration-toolkit
- [AI KPI report, verified](https://pablodpavon.com/proyectos/reporte-con-ia.html): an LLM drafts the monthly KPI commentary and a checker verifies every number before release. Code: https://github.com/pablodpavon/ai-kpi-commentary

## Casos de estudio (español)
- [Conciliación y caja diaria automáticas](https://pablodpavon.com/es/proyectos/conciliacion-y-caja.html): conciliación bancaria, cobranzas y proyección de caja a 20 días que corren solas cada mañana para una pyme.
- [Control de cuentas a pagar](https://pablodpavon.com/es/proyectos/cuentas-a-pagar.html): 12 reglas sobre 1.260 facturas de proveedores, validación de CUIT y cruce con orden de compra y recepción antes de pagar.
- [Migración de datos con conciliación](https://pablodpavon.com/es/proyectos/migracion-de-datos.html): migración guiada por una especificación de mapeo, 4.060 clientes y 6.500 contratos, con 12 controles de conciliación.
- [Reporte de KPIs con IA verificado](https://pablodpavon.com/es/proyectos/reporte-con-ia.html): un modelo de lenguaje redacta el comentario mensual de KPIs y un control verifica cada número antes de publicarlo.
